scientific_integrity: The least-counterexample witness at (k,n)=(66,38) is credited to Scardino; only the complete preceding positive range is assessed as new. Infinite positivity uses a rigorous pole certificate, not finite enumeration alone.
scientific_limitations: For denominator degree five, establishes all-index positivity for numerator degrees 0 through 65 and sharp failure at 66; does not classify degrees exceeding 66, other denominator orders, or practical algorithm failures.
title: The first failure of reciprocal Padé positivity at denominator degree five
